releases.name: Astronomical 0.2.119
releases.body:
## Fewer storage reads while streaming

When a mixture-of-experts model is bigger than the memory you give it, Astronomical reads the experts each word needs from the SSD. This release keeps whole only as many layers as still leave every other layer a fair share of memory, and sizes those shares from the memory they actually have, so far fewer experts have to be read again.

- Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B 8-bit Astro Atlas at 17.6 GB: 21 to 49 experts read from the SSD per word, down from 71 to 109, and 32.1 tokens a second with nothing held in the macOS file cache, up from 22.2.
- The 4-bit OptiQ build at an 11 GB limit: 33.3 tokens a second, up from 25.1.
- Replies are word for word the same as before.
- Each reply's hits, misses and bytes read from the SSD now show in `/v1/experts` and in the log.

## New in the catalog

- **Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-8bit-vision with its DFlash2 drafter**, for draft trees on the highest-precision Ornith build.

## OpenCode

- `astronomical launch opencode` writes OpenCode's current configuration format and tells OpenCode the model's real context window. `astronomical launch codex` now declares the context window too.
- A new OpenCode plugin keeps every model Astronomical serves in OpenCode's model picker: `opencode plugin add opencode-astronomical`. It is published separately from the app; see the [local API page](https://getastronomical.com/local-api.html).

## Also

- The model engine is now built as several smaller parts. Nothing changes in what it does.

Your models, chats and settings are kept across the update. Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later.

Astronomical 0.2.119 is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the direct download and the signed Sparkle update feed.

releases.name: Astronomical 0.2.118
releases.body:
## Faster streaming from the SSD

When a mixture-of-experts model is bigger than the memory you give it, Astronomical reads the experts each word needs from the SSD while it writes. This release reads them with a new native reader, straight into the memory the graphics processor works from, with no second copy and no detour through the macOS file cache.

- Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B 4-bit as an Expert Atlas, 10 GB memory limit, nothing held in the macOS file cache: 22.9 tokens a second, up from 14.7.
- The same model at 20 GB: 19.7 ms a token, down from 26.1.
- Held whole in memory: as fast as before.
- Replies are word for word the same as before.

## New in the catalog

- **Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-8bit-vision as an Astro Atlas.** The same weights as the 8-bit vision build, stored so each expert is read from the SSD in one step. With a 10 GB limit it writes 16.7 tokens a second against 12.1 for the regular build.

## Also

- `astronomical models convert-atlas` now converts vision models made with `astronomical vision add`, whose vision tower sits in its own `model-vision.safetensors`.
- Astro's skills each have one consistent icon, and the home cards use the graphite palette.
- A failing drive is now reported as a drive error, not as a model file that is too short.

## Compatibility

Your settings, conversations and downloaded models carry over unchanged. Expert Atlas models made by earlier releases keep working.

Astronomical 0.2.118 is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the direct download and the signed Sparkle update feed.

releases.name: Astronomical 0.2.117
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **Screenshots from your coding tools now reach the model.** Agent apps such as GitHub Copilot hand a tool's screenshot back to the model inside the tool's result. Astronomical used to refuse that on the Responses endpoint ("function_call_output is unsupported") and quietly drop the picture on Chat Completions. Now the model sees it, on every endpoint, so a vision model can look at the page your agent just captured. In GitHub Copilot, tick "Supports image input" for the model in Settings → Model providers.
- A clearer error when an image in a request names a stored file or has no image in it.

## Under the hood

- Test comments brought up to date with the code.

## Compatibility

- Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later.
- Your settings, models and conversations carry over unchanged.
- A model that only reads text still declines images, now including images a tool returns.

Astronomical is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered as a signed Sparkle update.

releases.name: Astronomical 0.2.116
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Faster replies from the Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B model on M5 Macs.** When this model comes with its DFlash2 draft model, the draft model guesses a small tree of next words each round, and the large model checks all of them in one step. Replies decode about 1.28 times faster on short chat and about 1.24 times faster after a 10,000-token prompt. Every word is still the large model's own choice, sampled at your settings. From 2,048 tokens of conversation, a new M5 kernel reads the conversation once for the whole tree instead of once per guess, so long chats keep the gain.
- **A new model in the catalog: `Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-OptiQ-DFLASH2-4bit`.** It is the OptiQ 4/8-bit Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B with its DFlash2 draft model packed inside, about 22.9 GB. Get it from Observatory's **Models** page, or run `astronomical models download Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-OptiQ-DFLASH2-4bit`. On Macs without an M5 GPU it runs exactly like the plain OptiQ build.

## Fixed

- **The Tuning page's temperature now takes effect while requests keep arriving.** A change to temperature and the other request defaults used to wait for an idle engine, and could be refused while a client kept sending requests. It now applies to the next request, without restarting the engine.

## Under the hood

- Updated `crc32fast` to 1.5.5 and a CI action to its latest patch.

## Compatibility

- Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later.
- Your settings, models and conversations carry over unchanged.
- The faster drafting needs an M5-family GPU. Every other Mac runs every model as before.

Astronomical is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered as a signed Sparkle update.

releases.name: Astronomical 0.2.115
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Qwen 3.8 27B in the Library.** You can now download `TensorFold/Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-4bit` from the Library or with the `astronomical` command. It is a large all-round model that reads pictures and text, reasons before it answers, can use tools, and keeps a large memory window for long conversations and documents. It is a 15.0 GiB download. (#2305)

## Compatibility

- Your installed models, conversations and settings carry over unchanged; no settings were added or removed.
- Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.

## Distribution

This release is signed with a Developer ID certificate, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed Sparkle update feed.
